snippet.title: Sorry, My King - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Sorry, My King, a 1-bit pixel roguelike developed by Game Crafters Collective. Players will take to procedurally generated maps to engage in intense card battles to earn the gold necessary to pay a debt to the king. Sorry, My King is coming soon to PC (Steam).
